addons.name: uBlock Origin
addons.description: Finally, an efficient wide-spectrum content blocker. Easy on CPU and memory.
addons.fullDescription:
uBlock Origin is not an "ad blocker", it's a wide-spectrum content blocker with CPU and memory efficiency as a primary feature. Out of the box, uBO blocks ads, trackers, coin miners, popups, etc. through the following lists of filters, enabled by default: EasyList (ads) EasyPrivacy (tracking) Peter Lowe’s Ad server list (ads and tracking) Online Malicious URL Blocklist uBO's own lists More lists are available for you to select if you wish: EasyList Cookie Fanboy Annoyances AdGuard Annoyances Dan Pollock’s hosts file And many others Additionally, you can point-and-click to block JavaScript locally or globally, create your own global or local rules to override entries from filter lists, and many more advanced features. Free. Open source with public license (GPLv3) For users by users. If ever you really do want to contribute something, think about the people working hard to maintain the filter lists you are using, which were made available to use by all for free.

addons.name: Pywalfox
addons.description: Dynamic theming of Firefox using your Pywal colors
addons.fullDescription:
This add-on requires a separate script on your computer to work properly.

An installation guide is available here: https://github.com/frewacom/pywalfox.

Pywal is a tool for automatically generating colors based on your wallpaper. These colors can then be used to style your terminal, window manager, etc. This add-on will take those same colors and automatically create a Firefox theme with them, using the Firefox Theme API (no CSS). This allows for dynamic theming, without the need of a restart.

The reason that you need to install a script on your computer is because Firefox has no way of getting the colors generated by Pywal natively. Generated colors are stored in a file on your computer and the script handles the communication with your browser.

The colors used for the theme can be customized, either by selecting a color from your Pywal colors or by choosing a custom color using the colorpicker.

If you are using DuckDuckGo, the add-on has an option to automatically change the colors of DuckDuckGo to match your browser theme.

There is also an included CSS file that can be enabled. The CSS will style dropdown- and context menus, add bold text and more.

You can submit issues/bugs here: https://github.com/frewacom/pywalfox/issues

addons.name: AudioBookBay Magnet Assistant
addons.description: One-click magnet links for AudioBookBay—no login required. Features high-speed pre-fetching, bulk clipboard tools, and a secure, modular v4.0 architecture. Supports all mirrors, dark mode, and instant local caching.
addons.fullDescription:
Instant, No-Login Magnet Generation
* Direct Access: Skip the "Login to see magnet links" gate. The assistant extracts core data (Info Hash and Trackers) directly from the page to build functional magnet links instantly.
* Link Repair: Automatically identifies and fixes "broken" or empty magnet links natively on the site, ensuring your torrent client always receives the correct data.

High-Speed List View Tools
* Integrated Controls: Browse categories or search results with "Download," "Copy," and "Append" buttons injected next to every title.
* Intelligent Pre-Fetching: A background engine "looks ahead" to fetch magnet data for every book on the list before you even click.
* Customizable Pre-Fetch Modes: Tailor the speed to your needs with four pre-fetch settings:
* Always: Fetch everything automatically for maximum speed.
* Hover: Fetch only when you mouse over a button.
* Click: Fetch data the moment you decide to interact.
* Never: Disable background activity to save bandwidth.

Advanced Clipboard & Bulk Management
* One-Click Copy: Quickly grab a single magnet link for manual pasting.
* Bulk Append: Queue up multiple audiobooks to your clipboard at once. Perfect for loading lots of links into your torrent client in a single paste.
* Real-Time Feedback: The UI provides instant visual status updates (e.g., "Copied!", "Appended!", "Duplicate!", or "Loading...") so you always know the outcome.

Performance & Reliability (v4.0 Refactor)
* Modular Architecture: A complete rewrite of the extension core for 2026, ensuring faster load times, better stability, and easier updates.
* Smart Cache: Locally stores magnet links. If you revisit a page, the data loads instantly without any network requests or page parsing.
* Throttled Workers: Includes a configurable worker pool to handle background requests respectfully, preventing site-side rate limiting while maintaining high performance.

Modern UI & Universal Support
* Dark Mode Ready: Seamlessly adapts to your system's theme and supports site-specific dark modes for a consistent look.
* Universal Compatibility: Automatically works across all known AudioBookBay mirrors (.lu, .li, .fi, .nl, .is, .se).
* Privacy First: All data is stored locally in your browser. No external tracking, no accounts, and no data collection.
